notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield as a 1/0 due to Kaervek, and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
